product.name: Monoprice High Speed HDMI Cable to DVI Adapter Cable 6ft - with Ferrite Cores Black
product.description: *** !!! WARNING !!! *** Note that this cable is NOT an ordinary HDMI® cable. This is specifically for connecting a device with an HDMI connector to another device equipped with a Single Link DVI-D connector, typically found on PCs, projectors, and older video equipment before the HDMI standard became widespread. These cables can NOT carry audio. They carry video signals only!If you are looking for a High Speed HDMI Cable or a Standard HDMI Cable to connect equipment with HDMI connectors, please look at one of the following category instead:HDMI Cables*** !!! WARNING !!! *** Experience unparalleled connectivity and versatility with the Monoprice High‑Speed HDMI Cable to DVI Adapter Cable with Ferrite Cores. This cutting‑edge cable is engineered to deliver superior performance and reliability, making it the perfect solution for connecting HDMI‑enabled devices to DVI‑equipped displays with ease.At the heart of this cable lies a host of advanced features that unlock a world of high‑definition entertainment possibilities. With support for 1080p resolution, the High‑Speed HDMI Cable ensures crystal‑clear image quality, allowing you to enjoy your favorite movies, games, and multimedia content in stunning detail.In the realm of immersive entertainment, 3D technology has emerged as a game‑changer, captivating audiences with its lifelike visuals and depth. With the ability to handle the high bandwidth requirements of 3D signals, this cable brings your 3D experiences to life, whether you're indulging in home theater delights or diving into the latest gaming adventures.Prepare to be amazed by the breathtaking clarity and detail of 4K resolution, which offers a resolution of 3840 x 2160 pixels at 24 Hz. With four times the pixel density of a 1080p display, 4K resolution delivers unparalleled sharpness and realism, making it the preferred choice for state‑of‑the‑art digital cinema systems. Thanks to the High‑Speed HDMI Cable's robust bandwidth capabilities, you can enjoy seamless 4K support without compromise.Delve into a world of vibrant color with the Deep Color feature, which provides a minimum of 8 bits per color element, resulting in over 16 million color variations. For even greater color depth and richness, other versions of Deep Color offer up to 16 bits per element, providing over 281 trillion color variations. With such unparalleled color fidelity, your video images will truly come to life, immersing you in a visual feast of unprecedented realism and vibrancy.Experience the full spectrum of color expression with x.v.Color™, a cutting‑edge technology that realizes a wide color space based on the xvYCC specifications. As a trademark of Sony Corporation, x.v.Color™ delivers enhanced color accuracy and saturation, ensuring that your viewing experience is nothing short of spectacular. Currently supported by AVCHD™ and PlayStation® 3 devices, x.v.Color™ opens up new possibilities for enjoying your favorite content with breathtaking color realism and depth.Equipped with ferrite cores, the Monoprice High‑Speed HDMI Cable to DVI Adapter Cable ensures optimal signal transmission and interference resistance, allowing you to enjoy uninterrupted connectivity and pristine image quality. Whether you're connecting your gaming console to a monitor, streaming content from your laptop to a projector, or setting up a multimedia workstation, this versatile cable provides the reliability and performance you need to elevate your entertainment experience to new heights.From immersive gaming sessions to movie marathons and multimedia presentations, the Monoprice High‑Speed HDMI Cable to DVI Adapter Cable with Ferrite Cores is your gateway to seamless connectivity and superior performance. Discover a world of endless entertainment possibilities and unleash the full potential of your HDMI‑enabled devices with this exceptional cable solution.This cable is capable of the following HDMI video features:1080p Resolution ‑ The High Speed HDMI Cable has sufficient bandwidth to transfer 1080p video signals between 1080p rated source and sink (display) devices.3D ‑ 3D is the latest rage for both home theater and gaming. A High Speed HDMI Cable is capable of handling the high bandwidth requirements of 3D signals.4K ‑ The 4K resolution is 3840 x 2160 pixels @ 24 Hz, which is four times that of a 1080p display and the same resolution used by state‑of‑the‑art Digital Cinema systems. A High Speed HDMI Cable is capable of handling the high bandwidth required for 4K support.Deep Color ‑ The Deep Color feature provides a minimum of 8‑bits per color element (24‑bits total), providing for a total of over 16 million color variations. Other versions of Deep Color allow for up to 16‑bits per element, for a total of 48‑bits and over 281 trillion color variations, which really makes your video images come to life!x.v.Color™ ‑ x.v.Color is a promotion name given to the products that have the capability to realize a wide color space based on the xvYCC specifications and is a trademark of Sony Corporation. Currently, only AVCHD™ and PlayStation® 3 devices support x.v.Color.HDMI®, the HDMI Logo, and High-Definition Multimedia Interface are trademarks or registered trademarks of HDMI Licensing LLC in the United States and other countries. PlayStation® is a registered trademark of Sony Interactive Entertainment Inc. HDCP™ is a trademark of Digital Content Protection LLC. UL® and the UL logo are registered trademarks of UL LLC.
